decisive_passage: Contractor shall pay Subcontractor each progress payment within seven calendar days after Contractor receives payment from Owner for the Subcontract Work included in that payment, less retention under Article 7 and any amounts withheld under Article 9. ... Contractor shall withhold retention of five percent from each progress payment to Subcontractor. ... Contractor shall release all retention withheld from Subcontractor within ten days after both of the following have occurred: Final Completion of the Subcontract Work, and Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner.
